analogy.rationale: Prostanoid receptor antagonists block GPCRs (PTGER1/PTGER4) that most of these cell lines express at low levels, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other prostanoid-pathway modulators (agonists, thromboxane antagonists, COX inhibitors) that converge on the same prostaglandin signaling axis.
